title: CharaBase+0xDC SubStat storage shape and facet readers
scope: Map the CharaBase+0xDC sub-struct layout (CharaSubStatStorage) and the six SubStat facet reader N-APIs (Waste, Guard, Chant, Object, Breakage, MotionPack). Cross-confirm the existing write paths (0x0144/0x0145/0x0179) by decomping the SubStat sub-struct initializer.

summary.subStructAccessor: FUN_006EEC00 (BCS-Y-0354): lazily allocates 0x1C bytes at CharaBase+0xDC and returns the pointer. Initializes via FUN_006EEA80.
summary.subStructInitializer: FUN_006EEA80 (BCS-Y-0435): zeros the 0x1C struct then reserves capacity 0x14 (20 slots) for the status u32 array.
summary.facetReaders: Six CharaBase N-API impls (_getSubStatWaste/Guard/Chant/Object/Breakage/MotionPack) extract bit-field facets from a status u32 slot. _getSubStatStatus (BCS-Y-0353 context) reads the slot itself by sub_stat_enum index.
summary.facetBitLayout: Status u32 slot encodes Breakage (bits 0..7, one per sub-kind 1..8), Chant (bits 8..15, nibble per sub-kind 1..2), Guard (bits 16..17, single bits per sub-kind 1..2), unused (bits 18..23), Waste (bits 24..31, 2-bit field per sub-kind 0/1/5/6).
summary.extraStatU32: SUBSTRUCT+0x10 u32 encodes ExtraStat (bits 0..7), NetStatUser (bits 8..15, one bit per sub-kind 1..8), NetStatSystem (bits 16..18, one bit per sub-kind 1..3). Reader: _getActorExtraStat reads the low byte; writer: FUN_006FA980 (BCS-Y-0349) is the canonical merge-write+per-bit Lua-fire helper.
summary.modeBorder: SUBSTRUCT+0x18 u8 ModeBorder. Reader: _getSubStatMode (FUN_00707FB0, already documented). Writer thunk: FUN_006EECB0 (BCS-Y-0443) called from receiver apply FUN_008A32C0 for 0x0144 ChangeActorSubStatModeBorder. Mode-change Lua fire: FUN_007084E0 (BCS-Y-0444) fires _onChangeSubStatMode with old/new diff sets.
summary.luaSetter: _setActorExtraStat (FUN_007080F0, BCS-Y-0442) is the Lua-side write path; uses the same FUN_006FA980 helper as the server-driven 0x0145 receiver, merging only the low byte of SUBSTRUCT+0x10. Follow-up c2s tracing found no EventStartPacket builder/send call; no shipped Lua script callsite by name

openQuestions: The 8 sub_stat_enum values that index into the SUBSTRUCT+0x04 status array (Status / Mode / Waste / Guard / Chant / Object / Breakage / MotionPack as N-APIs suggest) are not yet mapped to concrete enum constants. Likely defined in a Lua-side table.

symbolsAdded.name: CharaSubStatStorageInitializer_FUN_006EEA80
symbolsAdded.role: Initializer for the CharaBase+0xDC sub-struct (BCS-S-0035 CharaSubStatStorage). Called by FUN_006EEC00 (BCS-Y-0354) on first access. Zeros the 0x1C struct (clears begin/end/capacity ptrs at +0x04/+0x08/+0x0c, the two u32 packed-flag fields at +0x10/+0x14, and the ModeBorder byte at +0x18), then calls FUN_007222D0(0x14) and FUN_00722DA0(0x14, 0) to reserve capacity 20 and zero-fill the status u32 array.

symbolsAdded.name: SubStat_getWasteImpl_FUN_006F9D60
symbolsAdded.role: CharaBase N-API _getSubStatWaste impl. Takes (sub_kind_tag, status_u32) from the Lua call frame; selects a 2-bit field from bits 24..31 of the status u32 based on sub_kind_tag (case 0 -> bits 30..31, case 1 -> bits 28..29, case 5 -> bits 26..27, case 6 -> bits 24..25). Returns the 2-bit value (or 0 for fall-through cases). Cross-references BCS-S-0035 CharaSubStatStorage status u32 facet layout.

symbolsAdded.name: SubStat_getGuardImpl_FUN_006F9E20
symbolsAdded.role: CharaBase N-API _getSubStatGuard impl. Takes (sub_kind_tag, status_u32); selects one bit at bits 16..17 of the status u32 (case 1 -> bit 17, case 2 -> bit 16). Returns boolean. Cross-references BCS-S-0035.

symbolsAdded.name: SubStat_getChantImpl_FUN_006F9EC0
symbolsAdded.role: CharaBase N-API _getSubStatChant impl. Takes (sub_kind_tag, status_u32); selects a nibble from bits 8..15 of the status u32 (case 1 -> bits 12..15, case 2 -> bits 8..11). Returns the 4-bit value. Cross-references BCS-S-0035.

symbolsAdded.name: SubStat_getObjectImpl_FUN_006F9F70
symbolsAdded.role: CharaBase N-API _getSubStatObject impl. Takes one Lua-passed status_u32; returns a triple (bits 8..11 nibble, bits 14..15 2-bit, bits 12..13 2-bit) as multiple Lua return values. Reads the same status u32 facet space as Chant + adjacent fields. Cross-references BCS-S-0035.

symbolsAdded.name: SubStat_getBreakageImpl_FUN_006FA020
symbolsAdded.role: CharaBase N-API _getSubStatBreakage impl. Takes (sub_kind_tag, status_u32); selects a single bit from bits 0..7 of the status u32 (case 1 -> bit 7, case 2 -> bit 6, ..., case 7 -> bit 1, case 8 -> bit 0). Returns boolean. Cross-references BCS-S-0035.

symbolsAdded.name: SubStat_getMotionPackImpl_FUN_006FA100
symbolsAdded.role: CharaBase N-API _getSubStatMotionPack impl. Simplest reader (68 bytes); takes one Lua-passed status_u32; returns the low byte directly (status_u32 & 0xff). Does not bit-shift further - the MotionPack byte is interpreted by the Lua caller. Cross-references BCS-S-0035.

symbolsAdded.name: SubStat_setActorExtraStatImpl_FUN_007080F0
symbolsAdded.role: CharaBase N-API _setActorExtraStat impl. Takes (new_extra_stat_byte) from the Lua frame; reads SUBSTRUCT+0x10 u32; calls FUN_006FA980 (BCS-Y-0349 canonical writer) with `(current ^ new) & 0xff ^ current` to atomically replace only the low byte while preserving the NetStatUser/NetStatSystem upper bits. Same writer fires _onChangeNetStatUser/_onChangeNetStatSystem per changed bit as the 0x0145 server-driven path.

symbolsAdded.name: SubStat_ModeBorderWriteHelper_FUN_006EECB0
symbolsAdded.role: 26-byte ModeBorder writer thunk. Calls FUN_006EEC00 twice (double-access pattern observed; first call ensures the sub-struct exists, second returns the live pointer), then writes `*(byte *)(SUBSTRUCT + 0x18) = new_value`. Single caller FUN_008A32C0 = ChangeActorSubStatModeBorderReceiver::apply for 0x0144 (BCS-Y-0349). The corresponding _onChangeSubStatMode Lua fire happens via the sibling FUN_007084E0 (BCS-Y-0444) on a separate path.

symbolsAdded.name: SubStat_ModeChangeLuaFire_FUN_007084E0
symbolsAdded.role: 689-byte Mode-change Lua-fire path. Reads SUBSTRUCT+0x18 ModeBorder, computes the diff between old and new values via FUN_006F1100 (a bit-packed list builder), and fires `_onChangeSubStatMode` via FUN_00447260 + FUN_00CC7A90 (the canonical Lua dispatch pair) with both old-set and new-set bit lists. Single caller FUN_008A3310 is the sibling apply path for 0x0144 ChangeActorSubStatModeBorder.

statusU32SlotEncoding.description: Each u32 slot in the SUBSTRUCT+0x04 dynamic array is a packed bit-field. Slots are indexed by sub_stat_enum-1 (per BCS-Y-0353's _getSubStatStatus impl).

bitRanges.encoding: 8 single-bit booleans; sub_kind_tag selects the bit (kind 1 -> bit 7, kind 8 -> bit 0)
2 nibbles; sub_kind_tag selects (kind 1 -> bits 12..15, kind 2 -> bits 8..11)
2 single bits; sub_kind_tag selects (kind 1 -> bit 17, kind 2 -> bit 16)
no reader hits this range in the catalogued N-APIs
4 two-bit fields; sub_kind_tag selects (kind 0 -> bits 30..31, kind 1 -> bits 28..29, kind 5 -> bits 26..27, kind 6 -> bits 24..25)

extraStatU32Encoding.description: SUBSTRUCT+0x10 u32 holds three independent packed facets. The canonical writer FUN_006FA980 (BCS-Y-0349) merges only changed bits and fires the corresponding Lua callback per changed bit.

bitRanges.encoding: u8 byte; readers treat it as one value not bit-by-bit
8 single bits; Lua callback _onChangeNetStatUser fires per changed bit with index = (bit_position - 7)
3 single bits; Lua callback _onChangeNetStatSystem fires per changed bit with index = (bit_position - 15)

0x0145_ChangeActorExtraStat.luaFire: _onChangeNetStatUser per changed bit in bits 8..15; _onChangeNetStatSystem per changed bit in bits 16..18

0x0144_ChangeActorSubStatModeBorder.luaFireSibling: FUN_007084E0 (BCS-Y-0444) fires _onChangeSubStatMode with old/new diff sets

closedQuestions.question: What does FUN_006EED90 walk, and is it the status-effect tick/expiration driver?
closedQuestions.answer: FUN_006EED90 walks a Lua ExecuteParameters state vector used by the Control::CutScene `_play` and `_replay` signature adapters. It is not a status-effect tick, not per-frame, and not connected to CharaBase+0xDC CharaSubStatStorage.
evidence: %BCS_GHIDRA_PROJECTS%\agent_a_followups_decomp.txt: FUN_006EED90 callers are FUN_006FB830 and FUN_006F11B0.
%BCS_GHIDRA_PROJECTS%\turn14_cutscene_helpers_decomp.txt: FUN_0074F810 passes FUN_006FB830 to FUN_00726880 for `_play`; FUN_00736150 passes FUN_006F11B0 for `_replay`.
FUN_006EED90's entry processors FUN_0071BA00 and FUN_0071CE70 are generic state/value accessors keyed by the entry+0x0C state byte, not status-slot readers.

closedQuestions.question: Does _setActorExtraStat (FUN_007080F0) emit a c2s packet or ride the generic 0x012D EventStart path?
closedQuestions.answer: No c2s emission was found. _setActorExtraStat is registered through FUN_00754FE0 and reached by the N-API dispatcher, but its implementation only reads the Lua argument, updates CharaSubStatStorage+0x10 through FUN_006FA980, and fires local Lua callbacks for changed upper NetStat bits. It does not call FUN_00776760, FUN_004D6D30, or the known EventStart wrappers.
evidence: %BCS_GHIDRA_PROJECTS%\lua_napi_c2s_trace_refs.txt: FUN_007080F0 references only registration data refs from FUN_00754FE0; FUN_006FA980 has callers FUN_007080F0 and FUN_0089C990.
%BCS_GHIDRA_PROJECTS%\lua_napi_c2s_trace_decomp.txt: FUN_007080F0 callee set has no EventStart builder/send functions.
